runtime_changes: APK 1.20.2 saves connection/access intents, starts native map entries in their instrument UI, adapts the cast page between stacked and side layouts, gives export feedback, returns to the cast tab after a cold-start host, and creates the named standby display at the selected full/small size. Instrument 1.19.3 keeps the 1.19.2 B2 HMI and full mask and only sets the small DXCenterDark multiplier to RGB=A, because field photos show the small layout composited as premultiplied alpha. Original scene, receiver, reference OS, MCU and version files remain. Neither version is vehicle-certified yet. The public tree keeps only the current build chain; retired version notes and component tools remain in Git history.
